notes.title: Demo Patch Notes: V.0.0.3
notes.content:
Patch notes: V.0.0.3

BUG FIXES:

-Fixed player falling out of the map in certain buildings
-Fixed broken collision when opening certain doors
-Fixed certain meshes colliding with each other
-Fixed random scaling of meshes
-Fixed parts of buildings not loading
-Fixed broken particle effects
-Fixed some grammatical errors in subtitles
-Fixed VHS tapes not working sometimes
-Fixed texture streaming pool at the facility map

ADDITIONS AND CHANGES:

-Added more props to the facility and Zabrodnik maps
-Added background buildings to the second Zabrodnik map
-Improved some 3D models with better geometry and textures
-Made it more obvious where the player is supposed to go at the roof section
